summary: Enterprise AI in 2026 is dominated by the three hyperscaler aggregators — AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, and Google Vertex AI — each offering managed, secure access to foundation models without data leaving the customer's cloud boundary. There is no single winner; the best fit depends largely on an organization's existing cloud footprint, required model diversity, and compliance posture. Data-platform players like Snowflake Cortex and Databricks, plus IBM watsonx, Oracle, and Cloudflare, round out the market by bringing models to where the data already lives.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and security: prompts and completions stay within the company's existing cloud VPC/region and are not used to train vendor models, satisfying strict data-governance requirements.
Compliance and certifications: aggregators inherit the hyperscaler's SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and regional controls, which are far harder to obtain from direct vendor APIs.
Consolidated billing and existing cloud contracts: usage draws down committed spend (EDP/MACC) and appears on a single cloud invoice instead of many separate vendor relationships.
Model choice behind one API: a single managed endpoint provides access to Claude, Llama, Mistral, GPT, Gemini, and others, avoiding lock-in to any one model provider.
Enterprise tooling: integrated IAM, audit logging, private networking, fine-tuning, guardrails, and observability that direct consumer APIs typically lack.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (on-demand) plus Provisioned Throughput reserved capacity; usage billed through the AWS account and drawable against EDP commitments.
platforms.best_for: Organizations already on AWS wanting the widest model choice behind a single managed API.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service (Azure AI Foundry)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; billed through Azure and drawable against MACC commitments.
key_features: Azure Monitor and diagnostic audit logs
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-first enterprises standardized on Azure, Entra ID, and the OpenAI frontier model family.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token on-demand plus Provisioned Throughput sold in GSUs (e.g., 25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash ≈ 67,250 tokens/sec sustained); billed through Google Cloud.
key_features: Grounding with Google Search / RAG Engine
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud shops and teams wanting Gemini plus multimodal and grounding capabilities.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumed as Snowflake credits (compute-based) via serverless LLM functions; no separate token contract required.
key_features: Models run inside the Snowflake data perimeter
SQL and REST access to LLMs
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting to run LLMs directly against governed data in the Snowflake warehouse with zero data movement.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for Foundation Model APIs plus DBU compute consumption for serving and fine-tuning.
platforms.best_for: Data and ML teams building custom and RAG applications on top of a governed lakehouse.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Subscription plus Resource Unit (token) consumption; available on IBM Cloud, on-prem, and hybrid via Cloud Pak for Data.
key_features: Granite open models with IP indemnification
platforms.best_for: Regulated industries and governments needing hybrid/on-prem deployment with strong AI governance.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-character/token on-demand plus dedicated AI cluster hosting for reserved capacity; billed through OCI.
key_features: Integration with Oracle Fusion/Database 23ai vector search
platforms.best_for: Oracle database and Fusion Applications customers wanting GenAI close to Oracle-governed data.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-neuron / per-request serverless pricing with a free tier; billed through Cloudflare.
key_features: AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting and logging
platforms.best_for: Developers needing fast, low-latency open-model inference at the edge with minimal ops overhead.
